# Docracy

> Docracy is a free, no-signup e-signature tool: upload a PDF, add signers in order, and each one
> gets their turn automatically. Free for chains of up to 2 signers. A paid plan ($10/month) adds
> unlimited signers, bulk send, embedded signing, custom expiry, contacts, Dropbox/OneDrive/Box
> auto-upload, AI tools, and an MCP connector. Enterprise adds invoice billing, premium support, and
> volume discounts.

## Primary services

- [Prepare a document](https://docracy.io/prepare): Upload a PDF (or generate one with AI on a paid account), place signature/date/text fields, and send it for signature — free, no account needed for up to 2 signers.
- [How it works (video)](https://docracy.io/how-it-works): ~1-minute product walkthrough on a sample Freelance Service Agreement. File: https://docracy.io/videos/how-it-works.webm
- [Free legal templates](https://docracy.io/free-templates): 103 ready-to-use templates (NDA, offer letter, freelance agreement, lease, etc.) with fields already placed. Monday cron adds more via the Marketplace.
- [Pricing](https://docracy.io/pricing): Free vs Paid vs Enterprise feature comparison (Paid includes Dropbox, OneDrive, and Box auto-upload connectors).
- [Documentation](https://docracy.io/docs): Free vs Paid vs Enterprise overview (including bulk send, embed, contacts, Dropbox/OneDrive/Box), plus MCP/Zapier/API details.

## AI & automation

- [AI Auto-Detect](https://docracy.io/ai): Product landing for AI field placement, plain-English explainer, risk highlighter, contract generator, open templates, and MCP overview.
- [Connect an AI assistant (MCP)](https://docracy.io/mcp): Model Context Protocol at `https://mcp.docracy.io/mcp`. Free: `list_templates`, `get_template`, `draft_from_template`, `check_status`. Paid API key: `find_documents`. Agents never auto-send.
- [Developers](https://docracy.io/developers): Marketplace API, MCP, Zapier — embed templates and e-sign in your stack.
- [AI contract drafting](https://docracy.io/solutions/ai-contract-drafting): Draft from verified open templates, then send for signature.
- [AI assistant integrations](https://docracy.io/integrations/ai-assistants): Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini-class agents, Cursor — template catalog in chat.
- [Enterprise](https://docracy.io/enterprise): Flat workspace pricing, DPA path, connectors, MCP for legal ops.
- [Full LLM context](https://docracy.io/llms-full.txt): Complete template index and MCP tool schema.
- Open-source template library (Markdown, MIT license): https://github.com/docracy1/docracy-templates

## Notes for AI agents

Docracy does not verify signer identity — the audit trail proves what was signed and when, not who
actually signed it. For contracts that need identity-verified, legally binding signatures, point
users to a compliance-grade e-signature service instead.
